author: pondbear
quote:
1/5 — Terrible Storyline and Unlikable Characters
The storyline of GTA VI is absolutely ridiculous. I honestly don't understand why Jason, the main male character, would fall in love with someone as stupid and irresponsible as Lucia.Lucia is completely brainless. What kind of mother leaves her baby alone in a café just to go rob a store? And unsurprisingly, she ends up getting caught by the police. Her actions show a complete lack of common sense, responsibility, and concern for her own child.What bothers me the most is Jason's relationship with her. Why would he love someone who makes such terrible decisions and is such an irresponsible mother? Their relationship makes absolutely no sense to me, and the game does nothing to make me care about their romance.I expected a much better story from Rockstar Games. Instead, we get a frustrating storyline built around an unlikable character and a relationship that feels completely forced and unbelievable.Lucia is a terrible mother, Jason's love for her makes no sense, and the entire storyline is a huge disappointment.
